summary: The address given for a polling place sends voters somewhere else.
realLife: In Henry County the polling place's address sent voters to a middle school.
sources: NBC News, midterms 2018: voters face malfunctioning machines and long lines across the country: https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/elections/midterms-2018-voters-face-malfunctioning-machines-long-lines-polls-across-n932156
inGame: needs: a published polling-place address that can be wrong; the voting module's rows

turns.turn: The address is right and the line is short
